name: okc Fabric Market LLC
old_description: OKC Fabric Market brings over 30 years of fabric experience. Our mission: to provide variety, high quality fabrics, with affordable prices! Our passion for excellence is what inspired us in the beginning and it continues to drive us today!
about:
OKC Fabric Market LLC operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma. The company states it has over 30 years of experience in the fabric industry, though a specific founding year is not disclosed. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly provided.

The business sells a wide range of fabrics through an e-commerce platform, offering products such as fringe, printed borders, and custom-designed fabrics. A notable service is custom fabric printing, which the company advertises as being produced locally in Oklahoma City. The website features a shopping cart system and displays regular and sale pricing per unit. No information is given about facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

The store serves both retail consumers and business customers, with a specific note that Canadian customers must email to place orders. The product listings include designs such as "3 Band Turtle Border on Yellow" and "3 Chiefs by Sherman Chaddelsone", indicating collaborations with artists. The assortment suggests a focus on sewing, quilting, and craft enthusiasts, though no industrial sectors are explicitly listed.

The company describes its mission as providing variety, high-quality fabrics at affordable prices, driven by a passion for excellence that inspired its founding and continues to guide its operations.
